name: Il -Isle-
source:
Main character gets to another world. He is named "One" by girls and boys there, and he is claimed to have the "right". Protagonist does not remember his identity, so he needs to find answer by travelling between two worlds with the keys he recovers.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公来到了另一个世界。那里的少男少女们为他取名“尾根”，并声称他拥有“权利”。主人公记不起自己的身份，因此必须借助找回的钥匙，在两个世界之间穿行，寻找答案。

（摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]）
